items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Lewis DeMaine was the director of the man during that time.

ctx.x: Oh, that used to be beautiful there. Yeah, it was. Those trees and everything. It was nice.
We had to pitch back. Lewis DeMaine was the director of the man during that time. Lewis DeMaine. We were talking here, man. Lewis DeMaine.
Yeah, I never did meet him.
